description: Local PDFs whose upstream source record carries the DOI of a different work (audit round 3, POSTFIX A6-N5). The PDF (identified by the first 16 hex of its SHA-256) is registered under its own key with the citation printed on its title page; the DOI is not used for values read from it. Each entry was read on the rendered title page (page, image hash).
